name: OracleTemplate.Muon.averaged_bound
type_text:
∀ {Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (T : ℕ),
  1 ≤ T →
    ∀ (η c κ : ℝ),
      0 < η →
        0 ≤ κ →
          ∀ (A F Er : ℕ → Ξ → ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ),
            (∀ (t : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (A t) Q) →
              (∀ (t : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (F t) Q) →
                (∀ (t : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (Er t) Q) →
                  (∀ (t : ℕ) (ω : Ξ), η * A t ω ≤ F t ω - F (t + 1) ω + c + κ * Er t ω) →
                    (∀ (t : ℕ), ∫ (ω : Ξ), Er t ω ∂Q ≤ e t) →
                      1 / ↑T * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ∫ (ω : Ξ), A t ω ∂Q ≤
                        (∫ (ω : Ξ), F 0 ω - F T ω ∂Q) / (↑T * η) + c / η + κ / η * (1 / ↑T * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, e t)
